<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a retro‑SN2 disconnection: the forward reaction is an SN2 where a nucleophilic amine attacks a benzylic halide (C–X) to form a C–N bond, breaking the C–X bond (alkyl halide).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["alkyl halide"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["secondary amine"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C-X"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
